class.name: CgameClientPrediction
class.brief_description: Server-authoritative client movement prediction with reconciliation and visual error smoothing.
class.description: [CgameClientPrediction] applies inputs locally at once and keeps them with sequence numbers. When the server acknowledges a sequence number together with its authoritative state, [method reconcile] drops the acknowledged inputs and replays the remaining ones on top of the server state. The difference between the old and the re-predicted position is not snapped but folded into a visual offset that decays exponentially; errors above [member error_threshold] snap instantly. The apply callable has the signature [code]func(state: Dictionary, input: Dictionary, dt: float) -> Dictionary[/code] and must match the server's movement code. The entry named by [member position_key] may be a [float], [Vector2], [Vector3] or [Vector4] and is used for error measurement and smoothing. [codeblock] var prediction := CgameClientPrediction.new() prediction.setup(apply_movement, {"pos": Vector2.ZERO}, "pos", 2.0, 10.0) var seq := prediction.predict({"dir": Vector2.RIGHT}, delta) # Later, when the server acknowledges input `seq`: prediction.reconcile(server_state, seq) # Every rendered frame: prediction.update(delta) sprite.position = prediction.visual_state()["pos"] [/codeblock]

method.name: offset_magnitude
method.description: Returns the magnitude of the current visual correction offset.

method.name: pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of predicted inputs not yet acknowledged by the server.

method.name: predict
method.description: Applies [param input] locally and queues it. Returns its sequence number, which should be sent to the server.

method.name: reconcile
method.description: Processes a server acknowledgement. Returns the position error (magnitude) between the old prediction and the server-corrected re-prediction. Stale acknowledgements (older than the last one) are ignored and return [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: setup
method.description: Resets the prediction with the given movement function and initial state.

method.name: update
method.description: Decays the visual correction offset. Call once per rendered frame.

method.name: visual_state
method.description: Returns the predicted state with the smoothed correction offset applied to the position entry.

members.member: Position errors above this value snap to the corrected position instead of being smoothed.
The highest sequence number acknowledged so far.
The error measured by the last [method reconcile] call.
Maximum number of unacknowledged inputs kept; older ones are dropped.
The sequence number the next predicted input receives.
The state entry used for error measurement and smoothing.
The visual offset decays as [code]exp(-smoothing_rate * delta)[/code].
Number of corrections that exceeded [member error_threshold].
The current visual correction offset, of the same type as the position entry.
